description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for creating and editing checkbox input elements within the editor, including handling existing elements, and setting attributes like name, value, and checked state.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog when shown, setting up the checkbox element if one is selected.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of the checkbox element upon dialog confirmation.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Populates dialog fields based on the selected checkbox element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Creates or updates the checkbox element based on dialog inputs.
